original_test_intent: Verify that each applicable Type 17 Minimum Voltage field reports the approved lowest supported module voltage in millivolts, or zero as Unknown under policy, is consistent with configured/maximum voltage and module design, and remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records, SMBIOS version and length; gate the field by schema, bind the raw 16-bit value to locator/module identity, decode zero versus millivolts, compare the approved module voltage envelope and min/configured/max ordering, and repeat after reboot without voltage changes.
manual_activity: A user approves module voltage-envelope policy and reboot plan. No voltage adjustment or electrical probing is part of this metadata check.
required_inputs: Expected minimum supported voltage per populated locator/device class
Applicable SMBIOS version and minimum Type 17 length
Policy for raw zero Unknown and empty records
Expected configured and maximum voltage relationship plus trusted module specification
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and approved inventory; do not change memory voltage, timings or BIOS settings.
Do not read the field if the formatted length does not include it.
Interpret raw zero as Unknown, not 0 V; preserve raw millivolt value.
When all values are known, require minimum <= configured <= maximum under the approved definition.
Do not equate this supported-envelope declaration with a live voltage sensor reading; stop on ambiguity or reboot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate field presence, raw zero/millivolt semantics, per-device baseline and voltage-envelope ordering, then compare pre/post reboot evidence.
Do not alter voltage, claim measured rail behavior or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-device minimum/envelope values and Unknown/field-applicability policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, interpret module/board specification conflicts and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded line is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot prove structure length, locator, raw zero semantics or relationship to configured/maximum values.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 data; report locator/module identity, structure length, raw minimum value, Unknown/normalized mV result and min/configured/max ordering.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Minimum voltage scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and voltage/BIOS changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate Minimum Voltage by Type 17 length, decode raw zero/millivolts per device, compare trusted module limits and the complete min/configured/max envelope before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 implementations that include module voltage fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and module-spec/SPD decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Minimum/Maximum/Configured Voltage definitions and authoritative module/platform voltage specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds schema presence, raw zero handling, locator identity and cross-field envelope constraints.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncated offsets, Unknown misread as 0 V, wrong-slot limits and impossible configured/min/max relationships.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-device supported voltage envelope and field-applicability policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: These fields declare supported/configured values and are not precision telemetry; live rail validation requires a separate sensor/instrument test.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept Unknown for unsupported firmware or empty slots only when explicitly scoped; a board rail nominal value cannot silently replace the module's declared minimum supported voltage.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module identity, per-locator minimum/envelope baseline and zero/applicability policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17 records with SMBIOS version/length
Per-device raw minimum, Unknown/normalized mV and min/configured/max ordering
Trusted module/board specification comparison kept distinct from any read-only sensor context
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic voltage diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Minimum voltage has defined field and zero semantics; companion voltage fields provide constraints rather than conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Schema, numeric and envelope validation are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds structure-length, raw zero, identity and cross-field envelope validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-voltage-change safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates supported-envelope metadata from live rail measurement and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a decoded 0 V or isolated number from passing when the field is absent, Unknown, belongs to another module or contradicts configured/maximum voltage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Field presence, a 16-bit mV value and ordering constraints are deterministic software checks; no electrical stimulus is required by this row.
